title: Getting started: checking a field data delivery
text: ef_test() checks directions entry filter: Test 1 (asked): condition holds, item NA. failure means item asked although (interview broken item). Test 2 (asked): condition hold, item NA. failure means item asked although skipped. Missing codes like -97 -98 count “asked”. NA counts “asked”. condition written R code. Translate PV syntax like : Prefer %% ==: x == 1 NA x missing, x %% 1 FALSE. ef-tag block (“Beginn Block 2”) applies every item . Either add condition & (almb ), filter data block test items filtered data. many interviews broken , Test 1 produces many failures programming errors. Use check = "not_asked" run Test 2. See ?ef_test rule duration variables, matters items filled automatically without shown.
code: # aliz: --ef: if (h_panel = 1) ef_test(T_27AL, "aliz", h_panel == 1)  # almb: --ef: if (almod1 = 1, 2, 4), inside Block 2 with --ef: if (alintrop <> 2) ef_test(T_27AL, "almb", !alintrop %in% 2 & almod1 %in% c(1, 2, 4))  # several items with the same condition at once ef_test(T_27AL, c("alendm", "alendj"), !alintrop %in% 2 & (h_panel %in% 0 | aliz %in% 2))  # --ef: alle ef_test(T_27AL, "alnr", TRUE)
